Subject: CPPO: Nordic reseller SKU/billing entity orchestration

Hi Peter,

Thanks again for the call today. To keep the AWS Channel Private Offer (CPPO) work moving, we need a short mapping of your merchant entities and the billing flow you prefer for the initial Nordic launch (SE/DK/NO/FI) so we can validate AWS marketplace entitlements and VAT handling.

Ask:
- Please confirm the legal entities (name + country + VAT/Tax ID) that will appear on invoices for each SKU bundle.
- Which entity should receive AWS Marketplace invoices vs. which entity handles downstream billing to end-customers?
- Any special invoicing requirements (PO numbers, EORI, language) per country.

I've attached a template "reseller_entity_map.xlsx" — fill the yellow columns and return. Once we have that, Markus will draft the CPPO term sheet and I will start the DocuSign flow.

Timeline: if you can return by EOD Wed (15 Sep), we'll aim to have the CPPO created and submitted to AWS the week of 20 Sep.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Senior Channel Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Entities (short):

- NordicCloud DK A/S (DK) — VAT DK88990011 — local billing for Danish end-customers (invoice issuance to end-cust)
- NordicCloud NO AS (NO) — VAT NO12345678 — handled via NordicCloud AB for now (we will provide a local entity by Q4)

Invoice routing preference: NordicCloud AB receives AWS marketplace invoice. NordicCloud AB will issue downstream invoices to end-customers in local currencies.

Special requirements:
- Denmark: need PO number on invoice (customer request)
- Sweden/Finland: Swedish translations preferred for quotes in local sales process, invoices can remain English

1) Do we need a signed reseller MSA before CPPO creation?
2) How will tax reclaim / VAT reverse-charge be represented on the marketplace invoice?

I'll finish the spreadsheet and send it back by Wednesday.

Peter — great, thanks for the quick answers and the tax summary. A few clarifications and next steps below.

Answers:
- Reseller MSA: We can start CPPO creation without a fully executed MSA, but AWS often requires proof of commercial relationship for onboarding checks. If you have a countersigned MSA draft, please attach; otherwise we can proceed with a signed CPPO term sheet + PO evidence and follow up on MSA in parallel.
- VAT handling: For marketplace invoicing, AWS will invoice the merchant of record (NordicCloud AB). VAT reverse-charge or local VAT handling is out-of-band — Redwood and NordicCloud will need to show the correct VAT IDs on our internal mapping so AWS marketplace settlement is correct. Markus will give guidance on required fields.

Attachments: I attached the draft CPPO term sheet (CPPO_term_sheet_v1.pdf) with the standard billing/routing options — please review points 3 and 5 (merchant entity + invoice address). Once you confirm the spreadsheet, we'll:
1) Finalize CPPO term sheet
2) Send DocuSign link to the authorized signatory at NordicCloud AB
3) Create CPPO in AWS and request entitlement mapping

HubSpot: I'm logging progress to the deal record here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234562/deal/67890 (Deal: D-2027-092-NORD). If you have a preferred PO template for Denmark, add to the reply.

Thanks,

Ben

Hi all,

A few operational notes from the Redwood side on invoice routing and entitlements:

- AWS will require the merchant-of-record entity to be consistent with the Seller of Record in their system (NordicCloud AB in this case). That maps to the "merchant_entity" field in the CPPO.
- For Denmark PO requirement: we can include an invoice field mapping so AWS passes the PO through as an invoice line — ensure your PO format matches their system (we can validate once you send a sample).
- Billing split / commission: recommend we set the CPPO SKU to be invoiced to NordicCloud AB and then establish a post-settlement revenue share under your reseller agreement; Redwood will not be splitting AWS invoices. Commission mechanics should be handled on NordicCloud's side and reflected in the reseller MSA.

Docs: I'll circulate a checklist of fields AWS will need (merchant name, VAT, billing address, contact, invoice routing preference, legal entity ID). For now fill the spreadsheet with those columns.

Operational ask: Peter — when you send the completed sheet, include the name and email of the signatory for DocuSign and the legal address to appear on the CPPO.

I'll follow up later today with the checklist.

- Markus
Head of Channel Operations | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
